text: The Forest Hill, Leaside and North Toronto Arena Nominating Panel will interview and recommend one candidate to North York Community Council for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board.

The Forest Hill, Leaside and North Toronto Arena Nominating Panel recommends that: 1. North York Community Council appoint Glenn Asano to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending February 22, 2021, and until successors are appointed. 2. North York Community Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (April 6, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board.
